description: The named parts of RimWorld's main loop, for rimworld-perf. Each phase is the first whose pattern matches a method on the stack, walking from the root; * and ? are wildcards over Namespace.Type.Method. Read from RimWorld 1.7.5011's Root_Play.Update and Game.UpdatePlay (November 2026); in the first recording of the game (17 November 2026, 349 mods) they matched 99.2% of the main thread. A second recording (18 November 2026), with the loop's methods under Harmony 3's names, added the alerts column, sound and the engine's own frame drawing: with them all but about 2% of its main thread is named. The loading patterns saw little time and are the least checked.
